docs.line_comment:
Comment-shaped trivia in capture mode (parsanol-rs#172): a comment
rides with the capture it precedes under `comments:`; whitespace is
never recorded; captured bytes never join span captures. The
comment DATA is pinned by the ruby differential spec
(trivia_capture_spec); this case pins acceptance across engines —
including the bytecode VM's decline-to-interpreter path on Ruby.

source:
## Semantics: K5, S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, T1, T3, C3, C5, C7, K1, A1, A2, M0, E1
grammar ConformanceTriviaCapture version "1.0.0" mode "v1" {
  ## Comment-shaped trivia in capture mode (parsanol-rs#172): a comment
  ## rides with the capture it precedes under `comments:`; whitespace is
  ## never recorded; captured bytes never join span captures. The
  ## comment DATA is pinned by the ruby differential spec
  ## (trivia_capture_spec); this case pins acceptance across engines —
  ## including the bytecode VM's decline-to-interpreter path on Ruby.
  line_comment = "//" ( *( !newline ANY ) )
  block_comment = "/*" ( *( !"*/" ANY ) ) "*/"
  newline = %x0A
  word = ( 1*( ALPHA ) ) as word
  num = ( 1*( DIGIT ) ) as num
  item = ( word / num ) as item
  list = ( item *( "," item ) ) as list

  skip = trivia capture: comments
  trivia = 1*( ( 1*" " ) / line_comment / block_comment / newline )

  entry document: list

  test {
    accept "alpha, 42"
    accept "alpha /* intro */ , 42"
    accept "alpha // head\n, 42"
    accept "alpha /* multi\nline */, 42"
    reject "alpha ,"
    reject "/* orphan"
    capture "alpha /* intro */ , 42" { word: "alpha" }
    capture "42" { num: "42" }
  }
}
